videos.title: All Killer: 00s Emo Anthems!
videos.description: An hour of the greatest emo tracks the noughties had to offer featuring Linkin Park, Fall Out Boy and My Chemical Romance.

videos.title: Rock Monsters! 2010-2019
videos.description: A definitive selection of rock and indie anthems from the 2010s! Starting with My Chemical Romance in 2010 right through to Liam Gallagher at the end of the decade.

videos.title: 30 Rock & Indie Heroes of the 20s
videos.description: From lockdown to a full-blown guitar revolution, Claire Sturgess has the finest from the 20s! Expect legends like Sum 41 and Green Day, plus new names like Sam Fender and Yungblud!

videos.title: The New Legends Of Rock
videos.description: Rock Riffs, Indie anthems and a new generation of rock legends from 2000 to now! Expect YungBlud, BMTH, The Arctic Monkeys, Fall Out Boy and loads more!

videos.title: 99 Reasons The 00s Rocked!
videos.description: 99 anthems of rock from the noughties! With Green Day, Linkin Park, The Strokes, Paramore, Blink-182, The Killers & much more!

videos.title: Rated Rock! The No.1s
videos.description: Number 1 rock songs from the last 50 years! With mega hits from the Arctic Monkeys and KOL right back to legends like The Stones and T. Rex!

videos.title: Rick Wakeman's WILD Things!
videos.description: Remember when rock was WILD? From '64 to '74 the pioneering heroes presented by a man who was at the centre of it all - from The Kinks to The Beatles to Black Sabbath to Queen!

videos.title: Don't Stop! 30 Feelgood Rock Hits
videos.description: From Peter Frampton and Free to Foreigner and Fleetwood Mac - the 70s was a feelgood and carefree time for pop and rock, and we bring back that vibe with 30 of the absolute best!

videos.title: Party Rock Anthems!
videos.description: Party pop rock anthems spanning 5 decades! From Queen, Kiss & Aerosmith to Blur, Paramore & The White Stripes.

videos.title: Sunday Rock Classics
videos.description: Rounding off the week with rock classics and anthems! We guarantee AC/DC, Nirvana, Queen, Meat Loaf, Bon Jovi & much more!

videos.title: Queen: Rock Icons
videos.description: Starting back in 1974 here is an hour of Anthems from the greatest British rock band in the world!

videos.title: 30 Biggest Rock Anthems!
videos.description: 30 of the biggest, timeless anthems! Featuring legendary acts like Aerosmith, Kiss, and Queen, through to Razorlight, Fall Out Boy and Evanescence.

videos.title: Sunday Rock Classics
videos.description: Rounding off the week with rock classics and anthems! We guarantee AC/DC, Nirvana, Queen, Meat Loaf, Bon Jovi & much more!

videos.title: Carol Decker's Leather & Lace!
videos.description: 25 years of classic rock from an era where the look was nearly as important as the music! From Led Zeppelin in 1970 to Def Leppard in 1995.

videos.title: Blazing Rock Ballads!
videos.description: The Biggest Ballads from the royals of rock! From Queen, Bon Jovi & Whitesnake to Meat Loaf, Nickelback & Evanescence.

videos.title: Big Hair & Power Chords!
videos.description: 20 epic songs loaded with mega hair energy & power chords! From 80s rock icons Boston, Whitesnake & Chicago to modern day heroes The Darkness, Green Day & My Chemical Romance.

videos.title: The Wild Ones with Suzi Quatro!
videos.description: Our godmother of Rock, Suzi Quatro is here with the wildest Rock Stars of the 70s! But who is the craziest and most outlandish? Bowie, Meatloaf, Queen or even Suzi herself?

videos.title: Loud & Legendary: The 20 Greatest!
videos.description: The most iconic and ear-shattering rock songs that shaped the genre! Including Led Zeppelin's timeless Whole Lotta Love and AC/DC's rebellious Highway to Hell. Crank it up and enjoy!

videos.title: Sunday Rock Classics
videos.description: Rounding off the week with rock classics and anthems! We guarantee AC/DC, Nirvana, Queen, Meat Loaf, Bon Jovi & much more!

videos.title: Nicky Horne's 25 Rock Rebels!
videos.description: Rock & Roll started as a rebellion and Nicky Horne brings you the 25 people who pushed all the boundaries & refused to conform! These are the greatest Rock Rebels of all time!

videos.title: AC/DC: Rock Icons
videos.description: An hour of Anthems and the biggest rock songs from rock legends ACDC.

videos.title: Heavy Metal Madness! Top 25
videos.description: Time to brutally assault your ears with the heaviest in metal music from the monsters of the 80s scene! Everyone can headbang along to WASP, Anthrax, Metallica and Iron Maiden.

videos.title: The Anthems!
videos.description: Turn it up to 11 for the finest rock anthems, featuring Kings of Leon, The Killers, Green Day, Biffy Clyro, and the Foo Fighters!
